semantics: The generic dependency-matrix row is a design inventory, not proof that every listed interface is a runtime dependency. This record classifies the current canonical 420Pay runtime dependencies without expanding authority.
companion_extensions: IReplayConsumer420 via ReplayProtectionConsumer420 for domain-bound mutable replay consumption

classifications.rationale: GenesisResidentAccess420 resolves and code-hash checks all shared dependencies and validates resident registration.
Settlement assets are resolved by canonical asset identity.
Configuration and lifecycle mutations require governance authorization through the canonical timelock.
Value-moving Pay actions use the shared pause boundary.
Current Pay runtime uses SettlementHealth rather than generic HealthRegistry.
Pay consumes qualified fee/settlement health and canonical swap execution; it does not directly read an oracle.
Merchant identity/credential policy may be composed externally; current Pay contracts do not use it for authority.
Human-readable naming is presentation/discovery only and is not Pay settlement authority.
Canonical asset and conversion-market health are fail-closed settlement gates.
PaymentRouter420 validates canonical conversion/protocol fee identity and expiry.
Current payer authorization is direct payer transaction or Genesis governance, not delegated capability execution.
Genesis-resident write paths use shared action-class safety state.
Current Pay core does not hold merchant/payer settlement custody; refund records are accounting authority rather than arbitrary release authority.
GenesisResidentAccess420 implements IGenesisInitializable420; it is a resident conformance surface, not an external dependency.
Current Pay contracts are non-proxy resident implementations with no migration execution path.
No Pay contract currently accepts a generic signed-envelope authorization.
Payment settlement reads canonical replay state and, for Genesis activation, requires the domain-bound mutable replay companion.
Operational writes fail closed on chain/protocol-major mismatch.
Invoice metadata commitments are checked when supplied.
Current Pay-specific payer and GasSponsor caps are local; no canonical IRiskLimits420 call is made.
Settlement assets must be eligible for canonical settlement.
No Pay runtime path consumes it directly.

authority_invariants: Registry discovery and runtime-code-hash checks remain authoritative for shared dependencies.
Names, Identity, Wallet, Indexer and UI surfaces cannot manufacture payment authority or finality.
The settlement adapter accepts execution only from its governance-configured PaymentRouter420.
The canonical swap executor trusts only explicitly governed callers.
Genesis activation must bind the PAY_SETTLEMENT replay domain to the canonical PaymentRouter420.
